name: outline-desktop
description: Outline Desktop - cross-platform client (macOS / Windows / Linux)
author: xu <george.x.qiao@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: npm run build:official-web && npm run prepare-official-web && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: npm run build:official-web && electron-vite build && npm run prepare-official-web
scripts.dist: npm run build:official-web && electron-vite build && npm run prepare-official-web && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:official-web && electron-vite build && npm run prepare-official-web && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:official-web && electron-vite build && npm run prepare-official-web && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:official-web && electron-vite build && npm run prepare-official-web && electron-builder --linux
